title: Free 4-Panel Comic Strip Maker
h1: Create a 4-Panel Comic Strip in Minutes
description: Design your own 4-panel comic strip for free. Our online creator has ready-made templates, speech bubbles, and characters.
intro: The 4-panel comic strip is the standard format for webcomics and newspaper comics. It provides the perfect structure for a quick joke, a short story, or a punchy observation. Our free online comic maker lets you drag and drop elements to build your perfect 4-panel comic without needing any design skills. For a deeper dive into story structure, read our [guide on creating comic strips online](/blog/comic-strip-guide).

faqs.question: What is the standard size for a 4-panel comic?
faqs.answer: A standard 4-panel comic is usually read horizontally and is typically 1200x300 pixels to fit comfortably on most social media feeds and screens.

faqs.question: Can I export my 4-panel comic?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can export your finished 4-panel comic as a high-quality PNG image for free.
